findings.title: Task 1.4's expected red run omits build.js, which the walk made a scanned member
findings.recommendation: Task 1.4 says the first red run "must list the 48 rename occurrences and the schema line and nothing else". The walk added build.js to the requirement's member table (scanned line by line), and build.js:14 still prints "Building OpenSpec...", so the red run will list 50 failures, one more than the task allows. An implementer following the task would read the extra failure as a scan bug. Change the sentence to "the 48 rename occurrences, the schema line and build.js's banner, and nothing else".

walk_entry.title: build.js prints 'Building OpenSpec...' during the documented git install, outside every check

commentary: Verified the two walks against the four files they touched (the residual diff from the external pass's commit lists only proposal, design, spec and tasks, each inside an entry's edit record). The admission rule is now stated the same way in the spec, the design and the proposal, and the new same-line scenario has a fixture in task 1.2. The design's "six entries, admitting seven occurrences" checks out against the list: the feedback entry admits both lines. The one miss is a count downstream of the build.js addition: the walk updated the member table, the design table, task 1.1 and task 2.6, but not task 1.4's expected red run.
